title: "Review and approve combined CVD metrics"

manual-review-status: reviewed-by-irh

::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this step does

Step 5 has three separate parts:

1. **Prepare** applies the approved disclosure-control rules and creates the private proposed public dataset and review evidence.
2. **Human review** checks the data-release identity, source issues, linkage summary, disclosure results, equations and plausibility.
3. **Approve** verifies that the reviewed files have not changed and creates the exact seven-file package allowed to proceed to Step 6.

The code calls the proposed public dataset the **candidate**. It is still private and unapproved. Neither preparation nor approval publishes any file.

::: {.callout-tip title="Procedure at a glance" appearance="simple"}
1. Run Step 5 `prepare` for the intended CVD event data release.
2. Open `step5_review.xlsx` first and complete the human review using the named supporting files.
3. If anything is wrong, correct the earliest source or code and rebuild; never edit generated review files.
4. An authorised BNR Lead or BNR Analyst runs the separate `approve` action.
5. Check `approval.yml`, `public_manifest.csv` and all seven approved files before Step 6.
:::

## Before you start

- Confirm that Step 4 completed successfully for the intended CVD event and mortality data-release pair.
- Keep every Step 4 and Step 5 file private.
- The person approving must be an authorised **BNR Lead** or **BNR Analyst** and must enter their actual name.
- Leave replacement off for a first preparation or approval. Use it only for a deliberate rebuild or reapproval; repeat the complete human review whenever prepared evidence changes.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input files"}

**Private staging folder:** `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/`

| File | Purpose and required check |
|---|---|
| `datasets/cvd_burden_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.dta` | Step 4 hospital-recorded burden statistics. Confirm the CVD event data release and plausible scope. |
| `datasets/cvd_incidence_rates_cvd_YYYY_MM.dta` | Step 4 mortality-linked counts and rates. Confirm the event/mortality data-release pair. |
| `review/cvd_incidence_rate_components_cvd_YYYY_MM.dta` | Private components used to check calculated count and rate relationships. |
| `review/cvd_dco_linkage_review_summary_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Non-identifying summary of DCO linkage cases requiring attention. Open the detailed private linkage workbook if the summary reports review cases. |
| `review/cvd_source_quarantine_summary_cvd_YYYY_MM.csv` | Step 2 source-quarantine summary. Open the detailed Step 2 workbook if its status is `review_pending`. |
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | Purpose and use |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do` | Main Step 5 controller. Routes the operator’s `prepare` or `approve` action. Run directly or through the dialog. |
| `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step5_review_expanded_cvd_prepare.do` | Applies disclosure control, creates review evidence and records the exact files supplied for human review. Called automatically. |
| `scripts/stata/metrics/cvd/bnr_step5_suppress_expanded_cvd.do` | Runs the nine-stage CVD disclosure-control chain. Called automatically during preparation. |
| `scripts/stata/monthly/bnr_step5_review_expanded_cvd_approve.do` | Rechecks the reviewed evidence and creates the approved seven-file package. Called automatically. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_step5_review.dlg` | Collects the data release, action, replacement choice and, for approval, the approver’s name and role. |

The full protection rules and implementation map are in [Disclosure-control rules](../../reference/disclosure-control-rules.qmd).
:::

## 1. Prepare the review files

In the Stata command window, replace `YYYY` and `M` with the CVD event data-release period:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do" YYYY M prepare
```

Only for an authorised rebuild, enter:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do" YYYY M prepare replace
```

Alternatively:

1. Choose **User > BNR > Update CVD events dashboard > Step 5: Review and approve package for release**.
2. Enter the CVD event data-release year and month.
3. Select **Prepare the review package**.
4. Leave replacement unticked for a first preparation. Tick it only for an authorised rebuild.
5. Run Step 5.

Find `STEP 5 PREPARE: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`. Confirm it reports completion and the intended data release, candidate rows, protected rows, disclosure checks, equation failures, DCO review count, quarantine status, review workbook, exact-files register and preparation log.

Do not continue unless all automated disclosure checks pass and equation failures are zero. An automated pass is necessary, but it does not replace human review.

## 2. Review the proposed public data

Open `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/review/step5_review.xlsx` first.

1. On **Review**, confirm the intended data release and read the instructions.
2. On **Source quarantine**, confirm whether Step 2 reported any protected source records. If the status is `review_pending`, open the detailed Step 2 quarantine workbook and resolve any source correction before approval.
3. On **DCO linkage summary**, check the categories and number of records requiring review. When needed, open the identifiable workbook under `$BNR_PRIVATE/data/derived/cvd/yYYYY/mMM/linkage/mort_yYYYY_mMM/review/` and resolve source issues before approval.
4. On **Disclosure QA**, confirm every automated disclosure quality-assurance check is `PASS`. Quality assurance (QA) means the automated checks that the proposed public data obey the disclosure rules.
5. On **Equation audit**, confirm that no equation is marked `FAIL`. For annual DCO counts, check that hospital-only plus additional DCO equals hospital-plus-DCO.
6. On **Row audit summary**, review the protected-row totals. Open `step5_row_audit.dta` only when a detailed row needs investigation.
7. Check the proposed public dataset, `step5_candidate.dta`. Confirm plausible counts, percentages, rates, trends and denominators; check related totals and breakdowns; and understand any unexpected change from the preceding public data release.
8. Confirm that labels, scope, notes and limitations are accurate. Protected rows must have blank numeric fields, `display_value` equal to `*`, and a clear disclosure note. Direct identifiers, private paths, credentials, logs, linkage evidence and disclosure-decision fields must be absent.
9. On **Fingerprint register**, confirm that `step5_review_basis.csv` lists the exact six files reviewed. The stored size and checksum act as change-detection values; approval will stop if any listed file changes.

If any check is unsatisfactory, stop. Correct the authoritative REDCap or mortality source, configuration or version-controlled code, then rerun from the earliest affected step and prepare a new review package. Notes or edits in a generated workbook do not correct the source.

## 3. Approve the exact reviewed files

Only after the complete review is satisfactory, enter the full approval command in the Stata command window:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do" ///
    YYYY M approve "Full Name" "BNR Analyst"
```

Use the actual authorised role: `BNR Analyst` or `BNR Lead`. Only for a deliberate reapproval, enter:

```stata
do "$BNR_STATA/monthly/bnr_step5_review.do" ///
    YYYY M approve "Full Name" "BNR Analyst" replace
```

Alternatively, reopen the Step 5 dialog, select the separate approval action, enter the actual approver name and authorised role, complete the confirmations, and run Step 5.

Find `STEP 5 APPROVE: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY` and confirm `Approved successfully`. Then open the `public_ready/` folder:

1. Confirm that `approval.yml` names the intended data release, approver and role and contains `promotion_status: pending_step_6`.
2. Confirm that `public_manifest.csv` lists exactly seven files. A **manifest** is the generated list of files approved for Step 6, together with their sizes and change-detection values.
3. Confirm that all seven listed dataset and metadata files exist. These are the proposed public files to inspect; there is no earlier formal `public_manifest.csv` during human review because approval creates it.

Approval means that the exact package may proceed to Step 6. It does not mean that the analytical package or website has been published.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

**Private review folder:** `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/review/`

**Private approved-package folder:** `$BNR_STAGING/metrics/cvd/cvd_YYYY_MM/public_ready/`

**Private preparation log folder:** `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/`

| File | Purpose and access |
|---|---|
| **In Private Review Folder**| |
| `step5_review.xlsx` | **Open this first.** Concise private workbook bringing the main review evidence together. |
| `step5_candidate.dta` | Private proposed public dataset after disclosure control. It is not approved until the approval action completes. |
| `step5_disclosure_qa.dta` and `.csv` | Automated disclosure quality-assurance results; every row must be `PASS`. |
| `step5_equation_audit.dta` and `.csv` | Checks of additive, comparator and count/rate relationships; no row may fail. |
| `step5_row_audit.dta` | Full private row-level disclosure audit, used for detailed investigation. |
| `step5_review_basis.csv` | Register of the exact six files supplied for review and their change-detection values. |
| `bnr_cvd_review_prepare_YYYYMM.log` | Private operational log for the preparation action. Approval does not create a separate log. |
| **In Approved-Package Folder**| |
| `datasets/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.dta` and `.csv` | **Approved** release-stamped data files created by the approval action. |
| `datasets/cvd_metrics_current.dta` and `.csv` | **Approved** current data files created by the approval action. |
| `metadata/cvd_metrics_cvd_YYYY_MM.yml` | **Approved** release-stamped data description. |
| `metadata/cvd_metrics_current.yml` | **Approved** current data description. |
| `metadata/metric_package.yml` | **Approved** package description. |
| `public_manifest.csv` | Generated list of the seven approved files, sizes and change-detection values used by Step 6. |
| `approval.yml` | Generated approval record binding the approver and exact manifest to this data release. |

All Step 5 files remain private, including the seven approved files, until Step 6 publishes the permitted copies.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If Step 5 does not complete"}
Step 5 should complete routinely when the Step 4 package is complete and the proposed public data pass the fixed rules.

| Situation | What to do |
|---|---|
| A source-quarantine, linkage, disclosure or equation check is unresolved | Do not approve. Correct the earliest affected source or code, rerun the required steps and complete human review again. |
| Approval reports that a reviewed file changed | Do not bypass the check. Reprepare the review package, review the new files and approve only that exact version. |
| The approver name or role is rejected | Enter the actual authorised person’s name and use exactly `BNR Lead` or `BNR Analyst`. |
| Review or approved-package files already exist | Confirm that a governed rebuild or reapproval is intended before using the complete `replace` command. Never replace files merely to clear an unexpected stop. |

For other uncommon problems, see [Fix common problems](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).
:::
